answer: Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. The panel reads the vine for a name, the horizon for a number, the knoll for a date, then asks the farm to account for all three at once. Lock 69 POA away per mask and a farm of 222 masks has 15318 POA frozen before the epoch opens. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Tile painter sea blue mark glazed at the press room, and the receipt must read each sea blue is a year of tilehouse logs in the tilery ledger. A hundred keys, zero proofs: the farm's story, told the same way each epoch.
